hero.title: From Order to Harvest in Three Easy Steps
hero.description: No expert required. Our smart system guides you every step of the way.

steps.title: Delivery & Set Up
paragraphs: Your Aquacubes system arrives at your door fully tested. Inside, you'll find a fully autonomous (supervised) components. A starter kit with small fish and fish food, and a quick-start guide.

Setup takes about 30 minutes. Fill and connect the tank with water, fill the feeding system, add the provided our Formula Q, and plug it in. The guided setup and from our experts and in our app walks you through every step with videos and tips.

steps.title: Grow & Monitor
paragraphs: Add your fish and seedlings. The system immediately begins cycling water through the biological filter, where beneficial bacteria convert fish celan waste water.
Our smart sensors monitor water parameters and water levels 24/7. The Aquacubes app sends you alerts only when something needs your attention — usually just a weekly feeding reminder.
The LED grow light automatically adjusts its spectrum and intensity based on the growth stage and ambient light conditions.

steps.title: Harvest & Enjoy
paragraphs: In 3-6 months, your first batch of fresh fish will be ready to harvest. Use the fish-and-come-again method — harvest half and let the others stay until you need them. A single aquacubes can yield from 600kg-1000kg harvests per year.
Fish like tilapia and barramundi reach harvest size in 4-6 months. Shrimp grow faster — 2.5-4 months. The app tells you exactly when each species is ready.
Replace harvested fishs with new seedlings from our certified seedling packs. The system is designed for continuous, year-round production.
